_comment: Codex model catalog for the Boyue gateway (https://apirx.boyuerichdata.com/v1).
Field set was determined empirically: codex validates this file at config load and
names each missing/mistyped field, so every key below is required by codex-cli 0.144.5
and the file was confirmed to both LOAD and complete a real turn against gpt-5.6-sol.
context_window 128000 matches CONTEXT_WINDOW_OVERRIDE=128000 in the run box's
secret/.env, which is what ale_claw runs with — keeping both arms on the same
context budget. The gateway's /models endpoint reports no window, and an oversized
input probe hit the TPM rate limit before any context error, so 128k is the harness's
own figure rather than a provider-reported one.
supported_reasoning_levels matches what the endpoint itself reports: rejecting a bogus
'xhigh'". Codex forwards the effort verbatim, so xhigh reaches the model.
NOTE: verified against codex-cli 0.144.5. The ALE fork (0.0.0-agenthle-20260614) is
older and its ModelInfo struct may require a different field set; ale_run's
_sanitise_catalog_for_fork exists for exactly that reason. This catalog is OPTIONAL —
codex runs gpt-5.6-sol fine with no catalog at all, given model_context_window in
config.toml. Leave model_catalog_path empty if the fork rejects this file.

models.description: Boyue gateway gpt-5.5 — argus's built-in default, listed so a role that misses its model override still resolves
